Package model

Class Profile

java.lang.Object
model.Profile
public class Profile extends Object
Holds a TA's profile information including personal details and the path to the uploaded resume PDF file.

The resume file is stored as a physical PDF under data/resumes/, and only its path and original file name are saved in the CSV record.

    • Profile

      public Profile(String taId, String name, String studentId, String major, String phone, String resumePath, String resumeFileName)
      Creates a full profile with resume path and original file name.
      Parameters:

    • toCsvLine

      public String toCsvLine()
      Converts this profile to a CSV line. The file name is Base64-encoded so that commas and special characters do not break the CSV format.
      Returns:
      a CSV line: taId,name,studentId,major,phone,resumePath,resumeFileName(Base64)

    • decodeBase64

      public static String decodeBase64(String text)
      Decodes a Base64-encoded string stored in CSV back to plain text. If the string is not valid Base64, it is returned as-is (for backward compatibility).
      Parameters:
      text - Base64-encoded or plain string
      Returns:
      the decoded plain text
